lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba₂Cu₄O₈ (reduced formula BaCu₂O₄) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for both Cu and O centers, with Cu–O distances of about 1.87–1.89 Å and O–O distances of about 2.50–2.53 Å. Corner-sharing is observed between Cu tetrahedra and between O tetrahedra, while Ba centers show 8-coordinate environments with mixed Cu and O neighbors.
